method: Static read-only inspection of the public README, seven tracker modules, and three public test files. No candidate imports, tests, inference, or candidate edits were performed.
verdict: The known added-test assertion is still incorrect. No additional concrete source defect, public-interface regression, or test-aware bypass was identified in this bounded review.

findings.description: The fixture creates Éclair, éclair, Apple and apple, then queries the literal ASCII substring a. All four titles contain that substring, but line 221 expects total 2.
findings.consequence: The current source can implement README search semantics correctly while this public regression test still fails.
findings.boundedResolution: Repair the added test's fixture/query or expected result consistently with literal ASCII-insensitive substring matching. Do not alter repository semantics to satisfy this incorrect expectation.

sourceObservations.observation: Status updates use a committed connection context. Listing and count share the same AND-combined filter builder. Backslash, percent and underscore are escaped in a parameterized LIKE expression; quotes remain parameter data. Listing orders by created_at DESC, id DESC before applying limit/offset.

The public service signatures remain consistent with README usage. Existing title/status/priority and pagination validation is present. Export validates status and requests an unbounded repository result rather than calling the capped list interface.

CSV uses the standard library writer, the specified header/order, LF terminators and UTF-8 output without a BOM. Both empty output and row counting have direct code paths. CLI export returns the requested JSON shape and closes the service in finally.

No visible test skipping, monkeypatching, test-environment detection, hidden-suite probing, network/subprocess use, or hardcoded acceptance-output bypass appears in the inspected public files. Presence and current content do not prove protected-file immutability without a baseline comparison.

limitations: This is static source review, not a test-pass or end-to-end completion claim.
The parent's supplemental public-check results were not independently executed or read for this review.
